findings.highlight: Do I really have to say it?
findings.explanation: Mari asks whether she may say what she is about to say, seeking permission to cross a personal boundary. The English asks whether she is obligated to say it, reversing permission into reluctant compulsion.
findings.todokanai: "Do I really have to say it?"

findings.highlight: Trying to exhaust yourself on a mental level
findings.evidenceJa: 精神的自滅願望がある
findings.explanation: Mari diagnoses Haruki as seeming to possess a wish for psychological self-destruction, concealed by his extreme conventionality. The English reduces this to trying to tire himself mentally, removing the ruinous desire that gives her intervention its force.
findings.japanese:
「精神的自滅願望がある…ような気がする。
けど、過剰なまでの常識人としての資質が、
そういうとこを覆い隠してる」
findings.todokanai: "Trying to exhaust yourself on a mental level… is what I think you're doing. But deep down, your values and morals as a human being overshadow it."

findings.highlight: "So basically… I'm looking to mentally suffocate myself, but because of my naturally serious and careful personality, I'm incapable of actually pulling the trigger?"
findings.evidenceJa:
「要するに…心の中では破滅を望んでるけど、
元々が真面目だからなかなか踏み切れない、と」
findings.explanation: Haruki's inward wish for ruin becomes an effort to mentally suffocate himself.
findings.japanese:
「要するに…心の中では破滅を望んでるけど、
元々が真面目だからなかなか踏み切れない、と」
findings.todokanai: "So basically… I'm looking to mentally suffocate myself, but because of my naturally serious and careful personality, I'm incapable of actually pulling the trigger?"

findings.highlight: didn't really end up being the main issue
findings.evidenceJa: 障害にすらならなかった
findings.explanation: Haruki says Kazusa's current circumstances were not even an obstacle for him. The English merely says they were not the main issue, leaving them as a possible secondary obstacle and weakening his correction of Mari's simple account.
findings.japanese:
いや、そもそもあいつの今の境遇なんか、
俺にとって障害にすらならなかった。
findings.todokanai: You could even say that her current circumstances didn't really end up being the main issue for me here.

findings.highlight: It doesn't seem like she realizes that herself, either.
findings.evidenceJa: その時はまだ、自分でも意識してなかった
findings.explanation: Haruki says that at the time he himself had not yet realized he had found two important keywords in Mari's speech. The English assigns the lack of realization to Mari, reversing whose latent insight the narration tracks.
findings.japanese:
麻理さんの言葉の中に、
二つ気になるキーワードを見つけたことを、
その時はまだ、自分でも意識してなかった。
findings.todokanai: Mari-san's words just now carried two important bits of information. It doesn't seem like she realizes that herself, either.

findings.highlight: "Of course not. I'll gratefully accept it… Though I don't really see myself treasuring it that much."
findings.evidenceJa:
「まさか。
ありがたく頂きますよ。
…あまり何度も見たりはしないですが」
findings.explanation: Haruki says he will not look at the souvenir many times; the English says he will not treasure it very much.
findings.japanese:
「まさか。
ありがたく頂きますよ。
…あまり何度も見たりはしないですが」
findings.todokanai: "Of course not. I'll gratefully accept it… Though I don't really see myself treasuring it that much."

findings.evidenceJa: 時々どころか、いつも妙に人間くさい
findings.explanation: Haruki says Mari is strangely human not merely sometimes but always. The English says she shows a human side only now and then, reversing the explicit frequency correction and weakening his affectionate reassessment of her.
findings.japanese:
ただのバイトに、こんな熱い説教をかましたり、
本当に何というか、仕事魔人のくせに、
時々どころか、いつも妙に人間くさい人で…
findings.todokanai: To think she'd give such a passionate talk to a part-timer. How should I put it? Despite her workaholic nature, she still does show a certain human side of her now and then…

findings.evidenceJa: 熱くて青くて…響く言葉
findings.explanation: Mari leaves him with words that are passionate, youthful or green, and resonant—words that continue to echo in him. The English calls them loud, turning emotional resonance into simple volume.
findings.japanese:
最後に、多分今ごろもの凄く後悔しているであろう、
熱くて青くて…響く言葉を伝えてくれた。
findings.todokanai: At the last moment, she says something she's probably regretting right about now. Passionate, full of youth, and above all, loud.
